headline: Accepted Mayor Sendroff's recommendation of Dawn Savo as Director of Finance, 14-0.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL 
SPECIAL MEETING  
INCLUDING PUBLIC NOTICE AND AGENDA FOR SPECIAL MEETING OF THE COMMITTEE OF THE 
WHOLE 
 
7:00 PM, OCTOBER 28, 2026 
MINUTES DRAFT 
Present - Katie Kiely, President 
Present - Sean Cardwell, Pro Tem 
Present -Sarah Gallagher, Maj Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Min Leader 
Present - Tasha Hunt, Majority Whip 
Present - Tom Figlar, Minority Whip 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Doug Foley 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Present - Ted Stevens 
Present -Tameeka Parks 
 
1. Call to Order/Taking of the Roll  
Legislative Council Special Meeting including Committee of the Whole, October 
28, 2026 called to order at 7:16pm.  The members noted above were in 
attendance; Minority Leader Anthony was absent. 
 
2. Public Comment 
Public comment was opened at 7:18pm, no comment was given, and the session 
was closed at 7:20pm. There was no written public comment. 
 
3.  Special Meeting Agenda  
   
(a) Submission from Mayor Sendroff regarding appointment of a Director of 
Finance as set forth in the following item requiring Council approval: Order 
providing for the appointment and approval of a Director of Finance, including 
a budget amendment; and, employment agreement. 
 
Referred by President Kiely to the Committee of the Whole
(b) Committee of the Whole – Agenda Chaired by Councilwoman 
Caldwell, Chair of the Administration & Settlement Committee. 
 
i. Call to Order/Taking of the Roll 
The following Council members were present:  
Rhonda Caldwell, Jeron Alston, Katie Kiely, Sean Cardwell, Tom 
Figler, Doug Foley, Grace Teodosio, Maurine Crouch, Abdul 
Osmanu, Sarah Gallagher, Tameeka Parks, Adrian Webber, Ted 
Stevens, Tasha Hunt 
 
ii. Order Providing for the Approval of candidate for the position of 
Director of Finance. 
Discussion and possible action regarding an “Order Providing for the 
Approval of a Candidate for the position of Director of Finance, 
including Budget Amendment and Employment Agreement [Item 
##4(a)]. 
 
Motion: Figlar 
Second: Alston 
 
A motion to go into Executive Session, to discuss the appointment 
and employment of a prospective candidate for the position of 
Director of Finance pursuant to CGS §1-200(6) was made by Council 
member Alston and seconded by Majority Leader Gallagher.  Joining 
the Council members in the Executive session were Attorney 
Mednick, Chief of Staff Peterson, Finance Director Hul and Mayor 
Sendroff.   
 
Chair Caldwell called for the vote to go into Executive Session to 
discuss the item.   
Vote: 13 in favor. 
 
iii. Committee Action following Executive Session  
Committee Action following Executive Session, if any, on Item #4(a).  
 
Committee Chair Caldwell called for a motion to come out of 
Executive Session.  
Motion: Figlar 
Second: Parks  . 
 
Chair Caldwell identified the candidate as Dawn Savo and requested 
a motion to amend agenda item 4(a) to include the candidate's name.  
Motion: Gallagher 
Second: Alston 
Vote: 14 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.
Chief of Staff Peterson introduced Ms. Savo. Chair Caldwell asked 
her to provide an overview of her resume.    
  
Ms. Savo outlined her 30+ years of experience in municipal finance 
and Council members asked questions. 
 
Chair Caldwell requested a motion to accept the mayor’s 
recommendation for Director of Finance.   
Motion: Figlar 
Second: Osmanu 
Vote: 14 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions. 
 
Chair Caldwell then called for the vote to submit the report from 
Committee of the Whole to the full council. All were in favor.  
 
iv. Adjournment of the Committee of the Whole 
Chair Caldwell made a motion to adjourn.  Her motion was seconded 
by Council member Figlar. 
 
 
4. Report of the Committee of the Whole:   
Council President Kiely accepted the Report of the Committee of the Whole and 
noted that it would be taken up in a subsequent meeting. 
 
5. Adjournment  
Motin to Adjourn: Figlar 
Second: Parks 
President Kiely adjourned the Legislative Council meeting at 10:33pm.
